The structure of composition Rb2Rb8Bi2O12 (reduced formula Rb2Rb4BiO6) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R3m (No. 160), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Bi and Rb centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Rb also adopts an 8-vertex coordination polyhedron. Corner-sharing between Bi and Rb octahedra and edge-sharing among like octahedra are observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component.
